findings.evidence: "Commuters can report a service issue by calling rider services. Station staff can also help with the same request in person."
findings.fix: Replace the second sentence with "Station staff can also help you report issues in person at any station."
findings.violation: The phrase "the same request" is ambiguous and confusing - it's unclear whether it refers to the schedule inquiry from the previous paragraph or to reporting service issues in this paragraph.

findings.evidence: "Passengers can check real time arrivals through the online portal. Station staff can also help with the same request in person."
findings.fix: Remove this sentence or replace with "Station staff can provide arrival information at any station kiosk."
findings.violation: This sentence is unclear and redundant since station kiosks already allow checking arrivals; "the same request" is vague.

findings.evidence: Link text reads "read the accessibility improvements list" but href="/fares/history"
findings.fix: Change link text to "read the fare history"
findings.violation: The link text describes accessibility improvements but the destination is fare history - they don't match.

findings.evidence: '<div class="icon-delete" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete item" id="s3-customcontrol">'
findings.fix: Replace with a real button element: ''
findings.violation: A div with role="button" is not properly keyboard accessible and won't respond to Enter or Space keys without JavaScript event handling.

findings.fix: Remove aria-invalid="true" or change to aria-invalid="false", and set to "true" only after validation fails.
findings.violation: The aria-invalid attribute is set to "true" on page load before the user has entered or submitted anything, incorrectly signaling an error state to screen reader users.

findings.evidence: Label says "Phone number (required)" but input is '<input id="phone" type="tel" autocomplete="tel">'
findings.fix: Add the required attribute: '<input id="phone" type="tel" autocomplete="tel" required>'
findings.violation: The field is marked as required in the label text but lacks the HTML required attribute, so the browser won't enforce validation.

findings.evidence: Three-step wizard with "Choose a plan", "Enter payment details", and "Confirm your order" in the "Fare adjustments" section
findings.fix: Remove this component or replace with content appropriate to fare adjustments.
findings.violation: This e-commerce checkout flow doesn't fit the context of a transit service fare adjustments page and appears misplaced or unfinished.
